about: The local models LatteOS recommends, best first: the first one that fits a computer is offered to it. Kept up to date in the project about once a month or two (ROADMAP 16n); any other model can be found and downloaded in LensAI › This computer, as in LM Studio. Sizes are the files', in bytes.

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B
models.good: The best answers and writing in Slovak of these; a mixture of experts (3B active), so quick on a processor with enough memory.

models.name: gpt-oss 20B
models.good: OpenAI's open model: reasoning, commands and code; a mixture of experts, quick for its size.

models.name: Gemma 4 12B
models.good: Google's: good languages and summaries; wants a graphics card with 10 GB.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.good: A good everyday helper; on a graphics card with 8 GB, or a fast processor.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.good: The best Slovak of the small ones; summaries and short answers (measured on latte-lab: 5–15 s).

models.name: Qwen3.5 2B
models.good: Small and quick on any processor: the micro-agents, a command from a sentence, translating (latte-lab: 2–5 s).
